_comment: MC-030 is a standalone sworn statement the filer may add to the first papers (DV-100's "Do you want to add a separate written statement of your own...?" brings it in). The filer is the declarant. The caption and the parties are answers DV-100 already has, under the same names; the court's county, mailing address, city and ZIP, and branch are asked here because DV-100's caption box holds only the court's name and street address. The statement continues on MC-025 when it outgrows its box. Field names come from the rectangles (pipeline-field-labels.js): the caption runs top to bottom as FillText35/34/32/37 (attorney or party, four lines), 31 telephone, 30 fax, 36 email, 29 attorney for, 27 county, 26 street, 25 mailing, 24 city and ZIP, 23 branch, 22 and 21 the parties, 15 the case number; FillText19 is the statement, 20 the date, 18 the printed name. The role boxes under the signature are for a lawyer signing for a party.

fields.label: Attorney or party without attorney - name (the filer, DV-100 item 1a)

fields._why: The court gives the case number when the request is filed; like every case number in the packet it is left for the clerk.

fields.label: Attorney for (under the signature)
fields._why: Only when a lawyer signs the declaration for a party; the filer signs it as themself.

fields.label: Plaintiff / Petitioner / Defendant / Respondent / Other (under the signature)
fields._why: The role a signing lawyer represents; one field across five boxes. The filer signs as themself, so none is ticked.

fields._why: Only with the lawyer's Other box above.
